verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Python and JavaScript SDKs, a web Playground, and an agent skill. None of these is an official TypeSafe command-line tool. The `claude plugin marketplace add` command belongs to Claude Code, the host platform, so it does not count as the product's own CLI. An API service could plausibly ship a CLI, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence that one exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
